content.title: Park Pavilion Rentals in Arvada
content.summary: The Arvada Parks Department offers 11 pavilions for reservation from April 1 to September 30, featuring amenities such as picnic tables, benches, and charcoal grills, though none provide permanent restrooms. Reservations can be made through the CivicRec website, and some pavilions are available on a first-come, first-served basis year-round. Notably, the Ralston Central Park Splash Pad area cannot be reserved and is intended for community use.
content.body:
![McIlvoy Park Pavilion](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=636 "McIlvoy Park Pavilion")

## Park Pavilions

The Arvada Parks Department offers 11 pavilions for reservation from April 1 to September 30 each year. All offer picnic tables, benches and charcoal grills, except McIlvoy Pavilion. Permanent restrooms are not provided in any of our parks or pavilions, however portalets may be available seasonally at some locations.

[Visit CivicRec and click on the 'Pavilion Rentals' tab](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog) to view availability. You will be required to log in or create an account in order to reserve a pavilion. When using a mobile device, you must create an account and be logged in to view availability.

[![Civic rrec website](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=3770)](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog)

[Reserve a Pavilion](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog)

The Parks Department also has several other park pavilions throughout the City that are first-come, first serve year-round. View our interactive park pavilions map below to see where pavilions are located as well as which ones are able to be reserved. [View the map in a separate window](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=ba9c43da8ccd4f4a9cd873db6c1bd661).

             iFrames are not supported on this page.

### Please Note

- **The pavilions and tables at [Ralston Central Park Splash Pad](/675) cannot be reserved.**They are first-come, first-served and are intended to be shared by our community. Please be considerate and limit your time at the tables so that others have the opportunity to use them as well.
- The Oak Park Picnic Area (the picnic tables near Ralston Creek, not the pavilion) is now first come, first served, and is no longer reservable.

## More Information

- Public parks are open from dawn to dusk.
- Pavilion reservations must be made a minimum of 3 days in advance.
- Pavilion reservations are valid from 7 am to 10 pm.
- All of our parks offer picnic tables, benches and charcoal grills. (Exception: McIlvoy Pavilion does not have tables or benches)
- Propane grills, tables, and folding chairs allowed.
- There are no permanent restrooms in our parks with pavilion rentals.
- If a portalet is not available at your pavilion rental location, you may rent one from a local company. See our [Policies for Pavilion Rentals](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/38594) page for more information.
- Amenities vary from park to park - [Open the amenities spreadsheet](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/7054/City-of-Arvada-Park-Amenities-XLSX&embedded=true) for more information
- Bouncy castles and other inflatable gyms and obstacle courses are prohibited in all parks.
- Food trucks are only allowed with a [special event permit](/663/Special-Event-Permits).
- All local public health restrictions apply.

For more additional information, visit our [Park Pavilion FAQs](/FAQ.aspx?TID=80) or view the [Park Pavilion Policy](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/38594).

## Alcoholic Beverages

No alcohol beverages are allowed in any park unless you have reserved an alcohol-eligible pavilion (Allen House, McIlvoy, Mechelen, Oak) during the pavilion reservation season (April 1 to September 30), applied for a beer permit and received written approval. In addition, the City reserves the right to ask you for a $100 damage and littering fee if the pavilion is found in damaged condition.

## Do You Need a Special Event Permit?

[Special event permits](/663) need to be submitted 60 days prior to your event and additional fees will apply. You will need to [apply for a special event permit](/665) if any of the following criteria are met:

- Event is to be held on public property
- Event is open to the general public (free or ticketed)
- Event anticipates more than 100 people attending/participating
- Event will have food trucks
- Event involves amplification (of music or speech) and/or lighting
- Event involves temporary structures (other than canopies and tables) or amusement rides
- Event involves traffic control
